prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Roentgenium (Rg) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a steelworks floor beside a glowing blast furnace, sparks and molten metal pouring under a high iron roof
Time of day: cool white overhead light, flat and bright; flat white light with crisp edges, no warm glow.
Outfit: a modern daily qipao — fitted mandarin-collar dress with frog buttons and side slits — in crisp white; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with a small jewelled hair clip; right now — the heat of the place has left a fine sheen on her skin, her top clinging lightly at the collar and the small of her back, a few damp strands at her temples; the fabric stays opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body facing the camera; head facing the camera straight on, both ears about equally visible; camera at her eye level; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.
PROP: with both hands she holds a small X-ray plate in a slim gold frame showing the faint white skeleton of a leaf in both hands in front of her — her own right hand holds one side, her own left hand holds the other side.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: relaxed brow, softly open eyes, lips closed and unstrained, no smile.

Framing: a chest-up shot — the bottom edge crosses just below her bust; waist, hips and legs are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — roentgenium: a synthetic superheavy element made only a few atoms at a time, first produced in 1994 at a heavy-ion research laboratory by firing nickel ions at a bismuth target for weeks to catch three atoms, and named for the physicist who discovered X-rays; in 1895, in a darkened laboratory, a screen began to glow yellow-green beyond a glass tube wrapped in black card, and he called the unknown rays by the letter for an unknown; one of the first X-ray photographs showed nothing of a hand but its bones and a ring, and he refused to patent the discovery so that every hospital could use it; it sits at the foot of the copper, silver and gold column and is predicted to be a dense, noble silvery metal heavier than gold, but its longest-lived atoms last only minutes, so no one has ever seen its colour — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.
